answer: Duplicate identities are detected when the same physical root signs multiple registrations, flagged like an island isolated from the main chain. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root key, verified through remote attestation. Attestation receipts are hashed and published, so any forged claim is a mirror reflecting the attacker's own stake loss. Sybil attackers must acquire genuine distinct hardware, making each fake identity cost the full bond plus device procurement, an ivory tower few can scale. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
